en: A black-and-white image showing a large castle-like structure with tall, ornate spires situated on a hill overlooking a river. The foreground features a steam-powered boat and some smaller vessels on the river. The architecture of the building has distinct Gothic elements, and the surrounding area includes smaller houses and buildings. There is some visible signage on buildings near the riverbank.
